## What this letter says

Yusuf's asthma appointment was cancelled. The clinic moved.

He has a new appointment. It is Monday 23 November 2026 at 09:15. He will see the asthma nurse. It is at Children's Outpatients, Blue Zone.

Keep giving Yusuf his brown preventer inhaler every day. It helps even when he feels well.

## What you need to do

1. Bring all of Yusuf's inhalers. Include his blue reliever and brown preventer.
2. Bring his spacer (the tube that helps him use the inhaler).
3. Bring his personal child health record (red book), if you have it.
4. If the time does not work, call 01632 960 588.

## Dates and medicines

**Old appointment:**
Monday 9 November 2026 — cancelled, clinic moved

**New appointment:**
Monday 23 November 2026 at 09:15 — asthma nurse, Children's Outpatients, Blue Zone

**Medicines:**
- Beclometasone (brown preventer) — every day, keep giving
- Salbutamol (blue reliever)

## Questions to ask your doctor

1. What happens at this appointment?
2. How will you check his inhalers work?
3. Will his medicines change?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
